title: Billing Hold Rules for the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
A representative places a billing hold on a patient-due Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account for exactly one reason, and only within the hold allowance: an account receives at most the allowed number of billing holds over its life, as its holds-used count records.

## Hold reasons and lengths

| Hold reason | Length |
|---|---|
| Itemization review | the class's itemized-statement collection pause, in calendar days from the hold start date |
| Charge dispute | the class's dispute hold, in calendar days from the hold start date |
| Coverage update pending | the coverage-update hold, in calendar days from the hold start date |
| Financial assistance application pending | until the assistance determination |
| Good-faith-estimate dispute pending | until the dispute outcome |

## Conditions read from the records

- A financial-assistance-application-pending hold requires an assistance application of the patient on file in submitted or pending-documents status.
- A good-faith-estimate-dispute-pending hold requires a good-faith estimate of the patient linked to this account in in-dispute status.

## Release

The hold is released when its reason is resolved or its length lapses, whichever comes first; release resets the account's hold reason to none.

## When the allowance is exhausted

A pending financial assistance application or good-faith-estimate dispute still stops every collection action on the account under those programs' own rules, but no further hold status is placed.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An account with two holds already used and a new charge dispute receives no third hold status.
- A patient whose assistance application is in submitted status may have the account held for the pending application; a patient whose only application was withdrawn may not.
